items.title: 美中推動優惠關稅待遇！中國2027、2028年各進口1000萬噸美國煤炭
items.title_en: U.S. and China Push for Preferential Tariff Treatment; China to Import 10 Million Tons of U.S. Coal in 2027 and 2028
paras: 美中貿易關係似乎正持續釋出緩和訊號。白宮表示，中國同意在2027年及2028年各進口至少1000萬公噸美國煤炭，雙方並將推動對總值300億美元的非敏感商品提供更優惠的關稅待遇。
根據《彭博》報導，白宮聲明指出，這項協議是在美中貿易委員會（US-China Board of Trade）架構下達成。
符合優惠關稅資格的美國商品包括農產品、海鮮、木材、化妝品及醫療器材；中國方面則涵蓋小型家電、玩具、節慶裝飾品及兒童汽車安全座椅等消費品。
此次進展緊接在美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平本週於華盛頓舉行峰會之後。關稅政策一直是美中貿易關係的主要爭議之一，川普第二任期以來持續將中國列為關稅措施的主要對象。
煤炭產業也是川普政府近期推動的重點。美國政府正尋求重振煤炭產業，以鞏固煤炭作為美國能源來源的地位。
川普今年6月曾表示，將動用數億美元納稅人資金，以強化煤炭產業。
此次與中國達成煤炭協議之際，美國能源價格正大幅上升。隨著新工廠以及支撐人工智慧（AI）產業的資料中心推升電力需求，美國電價也持續走高。
白宮另表示，美中已成立工作小組，專門處理農業領域的市場准入障礙。農業長期以來一直是雙邊貿易談判的重要議題。
此外，雙方也成立「投資委員會」（Board of Investment），討論投資機會並處理投資相關障礙。兩國同時同意繼續就美方對稀土及其他關鍵礦產供應鏈短缺的疑慮展開合作。
白宮表示，川普也敦促習近平提高精煉石油產品產量，以協助穩定全球供應。雙方並同意持續就新興科技展開對話，下一輪AI議題交流預計於11月舉行。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: U.S.-China trade relations appear to be sending continued signals of easing. The White House said China has agreed to import at least 10 million metric tons of U.S. coal in each of 2027 and 2028, and the two sides will work to provide more favorable tariff treatment for non‑sensitive goods worth a total of $30 billion.
According to Bloomberg, the White House statement noted that the agreement was reached under the framework of the U.S.-China Board of Trade.

U.S. products eligible for preferential tariffs include agricultural goods, seafood, lumber, cosmetics and medical equipment; Chinese‑eligible items cover small appliances, toys, festive decorations and children’s car safety seats, among other consumer goods.

The development comes right after President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping held a summit in Washington this week. Tariffs have long been a major point of contention in U.S.-China trade, and Trump has continued to target China with tariff measures throughout his second term.
The coal sector is also a focus of the Trump administration’s recent push. The U.S. government is seeking to revive the coal industry to cement coal’s role as an American energy source.
In June, Trump said he would allocate hundreds of millions of dollars of taxpayer money to strengthen the coal industry.

The coal agreement with China is reached as U.S. energy prices are soaring. New factories and data centers that support the artificial‑intelligence (AI) industry are driving up electricity demand, pushing U.S. power prices higher.
The White House also said a U.S.-China working group has been set up to address market‑access barriers in agriculture, a long‑standing issue in bilateral trade talks.

In addition, the two sides have created a Board of Investment to discuss investment opportunities and address related obstacles. Both countries also agreed to continue cooperation on U.S. concerns about rare‑earth and other critical mineral supply‑chain shortages.

The White House said Trump has urged Xi to increase refined petroleum product output to help stabilize global supply. The parties also agreed to keep dialogue on emerging technologies ongoing, with the next round of AI talks slated for November.

items.title: Fed可能忽視了柴油價格風險？美國柴油價格飆升83%恐推升核心通膨
items.title_en: Is the Fed overlooking diesel price risks? U.S. diesel prices surge 83% may boost core inflation
paras: 美國柴油價格近期大幅攀升，可能對通膨造成比聯準會（Fed）目前評估更持久的影響。Apollo Global Management首席經濟學家Torsten Slok指出，柴油不僅直接影響能源價格，其成本也可能透過運輸環節逐步轉嫁至其他商品與服務，進而推升核心消費者物價指數（CPI）。
Slok週五（25日）接受彭博電視《Surveillance》節目訪問時表示，柴油與汽油價格上漲的傳導方式不同。
由於柴油廣泛用於商品運輸以及資料中心等基礎建設，相關需求對價格變化的敏感度較低，因此柴油成本上升後，企業較可能將增加的成本轉嫁給消費者。
他指出，柴油價格上漲的影響「實際上會進入CPI能源項目以外的其他分項」，代表其通膨效應不會單純停留在能源價格。
Slok本週發布的研究報告進一步指出，傳統上將食品與能源排除在外的核心通膨指標，可能無法完整反映柴油價格衝擊。
柴油成本上升後，可能經過一段時間才逐步反映在核心商品與服務價格中，因此難以單純視為短期能源價格波動。

美國柴油價格年初以來飆升83%

根據彭博數據，截至週四（24日），美國柴油平均價格今年以來已上漲83%，達每加侖6.50美元，漲幅高於同期汽油價格59%的升幅。
美伊衝突干擾波斯灣原油運輸，推動能源價格全面走高，但柴油價格受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
柴油價格持續攀升，也讓聯準會如何處理能源供給衝擊面臨更多不確定性。7月聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議紀要顯示，多數與會者認為先前能源價格上漲的影響將逐步消退，並有助於今年稍晚降低通膨。
不過，芝加哥聯準銀行總裁Austan Goolsbee本週警告，如果供給衝擊造成的通膨持續存在，央行過去採取的「看穿」策略，其政策依據就會受到削弱。
Slok描述了一種聯準會隱含的政策期望，即寄望於伊朗戰爭的解決方案能夠緩解能源價格壓力，使央行無需進一步升息。他將此情景稱為「目前的孤注一擲」。
目前美國通膨率仍高於聯準會設定的2%目標，使能源價格衝擊是否屬於暫時性因素，成為貨幣政策面臨的不確定因素之一。

AI熱潮推升經濟　同時增加柴油需求

Slok另外指出，人工智慧（AI）相關支出熱潮是目前美國經濟在高利率環境下維持韌性的主要因素。
他估計，AI相關活動目前約貢獻美國國內生產毛額（GDP）成長1個百分點，約占當前經濟成長的一半。
這項影響來自資料中心建設、能源需求、軟體支出，以及股價上漲所帶來的財富效應等多個面向。
而資料中心建設本身高度依賴柴油，也使AI投資熱潮與柴油需求增加同時存在。Slok認為，在這種情況下，柴油價格上漲可能透過運輸與建設成本進一步傳導至經濟其他領域，使通膨壓力較難快速消退。
paras_en: U.S. diesel prices have recently surged sharply, potentially affecting inflation more persistently than the Federal Reserve currently assesses. Apollo Global Management chief economist Torsten Slok noted that diesel not only directly impacts energy prices, its cost can also be passed through the transportation chain to other goods and services, thereby raising the core Consumer Price Index (CPI).
Slok said in an interview with Bloomberg Television's "Surveillance" program on Friday (the 25th) that the transmission mechanisms of diesel and gasoline price increases differ.

Because diesel is widely used for freight transport and infrastructure such as data centers, demand is less sensitive to price changes, so when diesel costs rise, companies are more likely to pass the added costs onto consumers.
He pointed out that the impact of rising diesel prices "actually enters CPI subcomponents beyond the energy category," meaning its inflation effect will not be confined to energy prices alone.
Slok's research report released this week further noted that the core inflation measure, which traditionally excludes food and energy, may not fully capture the shock from diesel price increases.
After diesel costs rise, the effect may take some time to gradually show up in core goods and services prices, making it difficult to view it simply as a short‑term energy price fluctuation.

U.S. diesel prices have jumped 83% since the start of the year. According to Bloomberg data, as of Thursday (the 24th) the average U.S. diesel price this year has risen 83% to $6.50 per gallon, outpacing gasoline's 59% gain over the same period.
The U.S.-Iran conflict has disrupted Persian Gulf oil shipments, pushing overall energy prices higher, but the impact on diesel prices has been especially pronounced.

The continued rise in diesel prices also adds uncertainty to how the Fed will handle energy‑supply shocks. Minutes from the July Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting show that most participants believed the earlier rise in energy prices would gradually fade and help lower inflation later this year.

However, Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee warned this week that if inflation stemming from supply shocks persists, the Fed's previously adopted "look‑through" strategy would have its policy basis weakened.

Slok described an implicit Fed policy expectation that a resolution to the Iran war could ease energy‑price pressure, allowing the central bank to avoid further rate hikes. He called this scenario the "current all‑in."
U.S. inflation remains above the Fed's 2% target, making it uncertain whether energy‑price shocks are temporary, which is one of the unknowns facing monetary policy.

AI boom lifts the economy while also increasing diesel demand. Slok also noted that the surge in AI‑related spending is a key factor keeping the U.S. economy resilient in a high‑interest‑rate environment.
He estimates AI‑related activities currently contribute about one percentage point to U.S. GDP growth, roughly half of the current economic expansion.
This impact comes from data‑center construction, energy demand, software spending, and the wealth effect of rising stock prices, among other channels.

Since data‑center construction is heavily diesel‑dependent, the AI investment boom and rising diesel demand coexist. Slok believes that in this situation, higher diesel prices could further transmit through transportation and construction costs to other parts of the economy, making inflationary pressure harder to dissipate quickly.

items.title: AI算力狂撒錢能否回本？高盛：6大科技巨頭2028-2030年需創造1.42兆美元收入
items.title_en: Can AI Compute Power Spending Pay Off? Goldman Sachs: Six Tech Giants Must Generate $1.42 Trillion in Revenue by 2028‑2030
paras: 高盛近日發布美國科技業研究報告，針對大型雲端業者持續擴大人工智慧（AI）資本支出的投資回報問題進行量化分析，估算若要讓2026至2027年新一輪AI算力投資達到15%的投入資本回報率（ROIC），未來AI經濟需要創造的收入規模。
高盛以Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、甲骨文(ORCL-US) 及SpaceX(SPCX-US) 六家美國大型科技企業為對象，對其2026至2027年的算力投資進行收益壓力測試。
報告指出，六家公司若要讓這一輪資本支出跨過15% ROIC門檻，預估2028至2030年合計需要創造約1.42兆美元收入，相當於每吉瓦（GW）算力每年約產生116億美元收入。
高盛指出，大型雲端業者近期資本密集度明顯上升，主要受到大型語言模型Token使用量快速成長所帶動的算力需求推動。這波鉅額投資一方面反映當前算力供需失衡，另一方面也在因應主要客戶未來數年的算力需求。
隨著今年第二季財報季落幕，市場對AI資本支出的理解也逐漸轉向更長期的投資回報。高盛表示，從企業財報與管理層說法來看，市場目前逐漸形成兩項共識。
首先，大型雲端業者可望透過2023至2025年的前期資本支出，以新增收入及營運現金流取得可觀投資回報；其次，在算力供應吃緊及終端需求持續加速的情況下，雲端業者正進入2026至2027年的新一輪資本投入週期，目前算力服務價格也明顯高於高盛所假設的長期基準價格。
因此，市場關注焦點已從前期資本支出的回報，轉向2026至2027年新增投資在2028至2030年能產生多少回報，以及前一輪資本支出的ROIC能否作為下一階段投資的參考。
高盛在測算中假設，每GW算力平均前期投入約420億美元，其中70%資本支出用於算力硬體、30%用於資料中心機房建置，並納入較保守的折舊規則及持續營運成本等因素。
根據上述條件，高盛估算六家企業必須在2028至2030年合計創造約1.42兆美元收入，才能使這一輪AI算力投資達到15%年化ROIC。
高盛認為，AI資本支出在短期內大幅增加，勢必對即期投資回報形成壓力，但這並不代表AI商業模式存在結構性問題。隨著投資逐步轉化為營收及營業利益，本輪資本支出的回報有望在中長期財務表現中逐步顯現。
高盛並指出，Token價格下降與市場佔有率變化未必會壓縮AI整體經濟規模，反而可能透過提高AI的性價比，推動消費端與企業端採用。
從高盛的觀點來看，決定AI經濟最終規模的關鍵，不只是尖端模型業者的市場佔有率或定價能力，也包括不同算力方案的性價比。
隨著不同能力層級的模型及AI代理沿著性價比曲線發展，AI應用將從價格競爭較為激烈的商品化智慧，到具備較強定價能力的尖端智慧，形成更多元的應用場景，進而支撐AI基礎設施業者目前的資本投入。
高盛認為，不同Token所對應的商業價值存在差異，AI資本支出的回報也不會完全一致。不過，考慮到未來3至5年的市場成長空間，該行仍預期，未來18個月投入AI領域的資本有望整體維持良好的投資回報。
高盛在Communacopia科技大會觀察到的產業訊號，也反映AI應用正在進入下一階段。
其中，產業正從AI試驗及探索階段轉向實際部署；效率提升所帶來的回報及產品更新速度正在加快；企業也開始從單純追求Token使用量，轉向提升Token投入產出效率，以改善自身投資回報。
高盛認為，企業端AI滲透率若持續提升，將直接帶動雲端業者收入及前期AI資本支出所對應的增量營業利益。
另一方面，近期多款面向消費者的AI代理產品陸續推出，以Meta的Muse為代表，消費端AI正從以對話為主的產品形態，逐步轉向由代理執行實際任務。
高盛認為，隨著這類平台擴大，以及其他大型科技企業跟進布局消費端AI平台，長期算力需求可望進一步增加。
在商業化方面，消費端AI未來可能透過訂閱、廣告及電子商務等方式變現，而不同商業模式之間的界線也持續融合，成為後續收入成長的重要來源。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs recently released a U.S. technology industry research report that quantitatively analyzes the return on investment for large cloud providers’ continued expansion of AI compute capital spending, estimating the revenue scale the AI economy must create for a 15% return on invested capital (ROIC) on the new wave of AI compute investments in 2026‑2027.

The report focuses on six major U.S. tech companies—Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta (META‑US), Oracle (ORCL‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US)—and subjects their 2026‑2027 compute investments to a stress test of earnings potential.

The study finds that for the six firms to push this round of capital spending past the 15% ROIC threshold, they would need to generate roughly $1.42 trillion in combined revenue from 2028 to 2030, equivalent to about $11.6 billion per gigawatt (GW) of compute each year.

Goldman notes that large cloud providers have seen a sharp rise in capital intensity recently, driven by soaring token usage in large language models that fuels compute demand. This massive investment both reflects the current imbalance between compute supply and demand and prepares for customers’ compute needs over the next several years.

With the second‑quarter earnings season now behind us, the market’s view of AI capital spending is shifting toward longer‑term returns. Goldman says that, based on corporate filings and management commentary, two consensus points are emerging.

First, cloud giants are expected to reap substantial returns from the front‑end capital outlays made in 2023‑2025 through new revenue and operating cash flow; second, as compute supply tightens and end‑user demand accelerates, they are entering a new capital‑investment cycle for 2026‑2027, and current compute service prices are already well above Goldman’s assumed long‑run benchmark price.

Consequently, market focus has moved from the returns on early‑stage spending to how much return the 2026‑2027 investments will generate in 2028‑2030, and whether the ROIC of the previous round can serve as a reference for the next stage of investment.

Goldman assumes an average front‑end outlay of about $42 billion per GW of compute, with 70% of capital spending allocated to compute hardware and 30% to data‑center construction, incorporating conservative depreciation schedules and ongoing operating costs.

Under those assumptions, Goldman estimates that the six companies must collectively generate roughly $1.42 trillion in revenue between 2028 and 2030 to achieve a 15% annualized ROIC on this round of AI compute investment.

Goldman believes that the sharp short‑term rise in AI capital spending will inevitably pressure near‑term investment returns, but this does not imply a structural flaw in AI business models. As spending gradually converts into revenue and operating profit, the returns from this capital round are expected to materialize over the medium to long term.

The firm also points out that falling token prices and shifts in market share are unlikely to compress the overall AI economic scale; instead, they may improve AI cost‑effectiveness, spurring adoption on both the consumer and enterprise sides.

From Goldman’s perspective, the ultimate size of the AI economy is determined not only by the market share or pricing power of cutting‑edge model providers, but also by the cost‑performance ratios of different compute solutions.

As models and AI agents of varying capability levels evolve along a cost‑performance curve, AI applications will move from price‑competitive commoditized intelligence to higher‑margin, sophisticated intelligence, creating more diverse use cases that support today’s capital outlays by AI infrastructure providers.

Goldman notes that different tokens carry different commercial values, so returns on AI capital spending will not be uniform. Nevertheless, given the market growth potential over the next three to five years, the firm still expects overall investment returns to remain healthy for capital deployed in AI over the next 18 months.
Signals observed by Goldman at the Communacopia technology conference also indicate that AI applications are entering their next phase.

Specifically, the industry is shifting from AI experimentation and exploration to actual deployment; the payoff from efficiency gains and the speed of product updates are accelerating; and enterprises are moving from merely chasing token usage to improving token input‑output efficiency to enhance their own investment returns.
Goldman believes that if enterprise AI penetration continues to rise, it will directly boost cloud providers’ revenue and the incremental operating profit tied to early AI capital spending.
On the consumer side, a wave of AI agent products has recently launched, exemplified by Meta’s Muse, signaling a transition from dialogue‑centric offerings to agents that perform concrete tasks.
Goldman expects that as these platforms expand and other major tech firms follow suit in building consumer‑facing AI platforms, long‑term compute demand will further increase.

Commercially, consumer‑facing AI may eventually monetize through subscriptions, advertising, e‑commerce and other models, with the boundaries between these models increasingly blurring, becoming a key driver of future revenue growth.

items.title: 美光下周財報恐迎「蹺蹺板行情」 分析師：輝達Rubin效應明年才發威
items.title_en: Micron’s Next‑Week Earnings May Face a “Teeter‑Totter” Market, Analyst Says Nvidia’s Rubin Effect Won’t Hit Until Next Year
paras: 美光科技(MU-US)下周將公布上季財報和本季財測，Susquehanna分析師Mehdi Hosseini表示，美光本季(11月為止)的營收展望應該足以讓投資人感到滿意，但還無法完整反映輝達(NVDA-US)新晶片推出帶來的全部效益。

輝達Rubin量產 HBM4需求明年更顯著

美光正準備擴大量產下一代高頻寬記憶體(HBM)技術HBM4。Hosseini表示，美光下周三公布財報時，投資人可能迎來「蹺蹺板的一季」(a teeter-totter quarter)，意指隨著市場重新評估輝達商機分布偏向明年的程度，不同季別的營收預測也將跟著洗牌。
隨著輝達未來幾個月完成Rubin人工智慧(AI)晶片平台的最終定案，Hosseini表示，Rubin的產品量產與出貨擴大可能延至明年4月。他指出，目前輝達最先進Blackwell晶片的交貨時間已超過30周，平均售價則較前一季上漲逾30%。
Hosseini說：「因此，我們預期Rubin平台將在2027年成為HBM4更重要的需求驅動力量。」以此推估，今年下半年對營收帶來的影響「將非常有限」。

HBM4平均售價可能比HBM3e高逾50%

Hosseini表示，等HBM4開始放量後，平均售價將比目前的HBM3e產品高逾50%，讓美光及其他主要供應商「大幅受益」。
美光會計年度為每年9月至次年8月，2027會計年度已從本月初開始。Hosseini表示，他已將2027會計年度上半年的「數十億美元」營收預估，轉移至2027會計年度的下半年。
Hosseini表示：「總體而言，我們預期記憶體基本面仍將保持健康。」他補充，平均售價走勢可望優於目前華爾街共識看法所反映的水準。
Hosseini並預估，美光2027年每股盈餘(EPS)將達約200美元，遠超過市場所料的165美元。
美光股價周五(25日)小幅上漲0.16%至每股1082.28美元，今年來累計大漲277%。
paras_en: Micron Technology (MU‑US) will release its quarterly earnings and outlook for the current quarter next week. Susquehanna analyst Mehdi Hosseini says Micron’s revenue outlook for the quarter ending November should satisfy investors, but it still cannot fully capture the total benefit from Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) new chip launch.

Nvidia’s Rubin mass production and HBM4 demand will become even more pronounced next year. Micron is preparing to scale up production of the next‑generation high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) technology, HBM4. Hosseini notes that when Micron reports on Wednesday, investors may experience a “teeter‑totter quarter,” meaning that as the market re‑evaluates how Nvidia’s opportunity will shift toward next year, revenue forecasts for different quarters will be reshuffled.

As Nvidia finalizes its Rubin AI chip platform in the coming months, Hosseini says Rubin’s mass production and shipment expansion could be pushed to April 2025. He points out that deliveries of Nvidia’s most advanced Blackwell chip are already beyond 30 weeks, and its average selling price has risen more than 30% from the previous quarter.

Hosseini adds, “Therefore, we expect the Rubin platform to become a more important driver of HBM4 demand in 2027.” Based on that, the impact on Micron’s revenue in the second half of this year “will be very limited.”

The average selling price of HBM4 could be more than 50% higher than HBM3e. Hosseini says that once HBM4 volumes ramp up, its average price will exceed current HBM3e products by over 50%, allowing Micron and other major suppliers to “benefit substantially.”

Micron’s fiscal year runs from September to August, and the 2027 fiscal year began earlier this month. Hosseini says he has moved the “tens of billions of dollars” revenue estimate for the first half of fiscal 2027 into the second half of fiscal 2027.
Hosseini says, “Overall, we expect the memory fundamentals to remain healthy.” He adds that the pricing trend is likely to be better than what Wall Street consensus currently reflects.
Hosseini also forecasts Micron’s 2027 earnings per share (EPS) to be about $200, well above the market’s expectation of $165.
Micron’s stock rose modestly 0.16% on Friday (the 25th) to $1,082.28 per share, up 277% year‑to‑date.

items.title: 川習會落幕：象徵意味濃厚、實質進展有限 四大核心要點一次看
items.title_en: Trump‑Xi Summit Concludes: Symbolic Overtones Strong, Substantive Progress Limited – Four Core Takeaways at a Glance
paras: 中國國家主席習近平於 25 日結束為期三天的訪美行程。此行是習近平時隔十一年再次正式造訪華府，期間美方以盛大軍禮與高規格外交儀節接待，兩國領導人亦展現良好互動氛圍，惟雙方最終達成的實質性協議相對有限。
針對本次歷史性會晤，雙方除了同意延長貿易休戰期、相互交換禮物與致詞讚美外，也針對管控人工智慧發展風險的合作可能性交換意見。儘管這場被寄予厚望的歷史性峰會在實質政策突破上相對有限，但在美中地緣政治緊張之際，雙方已暫時達成穩定政治局勢的共識。
以下為本次川普與習近平會晤的四大核心要點：
一、 貿易停戰期延長兩個月
美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）宣布，美中雙方同意將即將到期的貿易休戰協議自 2026 年 11 月延長至 2027 年 1 月 10 日。此項協議最初於南韓釜山會晤時簽署，內容包括美方降低關稅，以及中方暫緩對稀土與關鍵礦物的出口管制。
儘管市場先前預期延長期可能長達半年，但最終僅延長兩個月。美國戰略與國際研究中心(Center for Strategic and International Studies, CSIS) 資深顧問 Scott Kennedy 分析指出，較短的延展期使美方能保留談判籌碼。
同樣值得關注的是，與川普先前訪華不同，習近平此次並未帶領大規模企業代表團隨行。北京外國語大學(Beijing Foreign Studies University) 國際關係學者Cui Hongjian 分析，這顯示美中關係目前仍處於優先鞏固政治穩定的階段，商業與貿易層面尚未迎來實質解凍。
中國外交部顧問Wu Xinbo亦指出，中方亦擔憂川普團隊中部分官員對雙邊關係的態度不如川普本人積極。
川普與習近平預計於今年 11 月深圳 APEC 峰會及 12 月邁阿密 G20 峰會再次會面，屆時貿易談判將持續進行。
美方正面臨通膨壓力、中東局勢動盪，以及臨近期中選舉等政治挑戰，這讓中國在維持「形式大於內容」的對話框架中依然佔據有利位置。
二、 避開「修昔底德陷阱」的外交論調
本次會談為兩國領導人繼同年五月北京會晤後，相隔四個月的再度接洽。習近平於白宮國宴致詞時強調，中國的崛起對美國而言是發展機遇而非威脅，並將其「中華民族偉大復興」的長期戰略與川普的「讓美國再次偉大」口號進行類比，呼籲兩國攜手合作。
中方在會後發布的新聞稿中指出，習近平抵達白宮時強調可避免「修昔底德陷阱」，主張兩國應進行健康的良性競爭，而非零和博弈。中國社會科學院 (CASS) 國際政治研究室主任Hai Zhao對峰會氛圍表示樂觀，認為中方對習近平在華府獲得的高規格禮遇感到滿意。
中國人民大學國際關係學院(School of International Studies, Renmin University of China) 教授Cui Shoujun分析，雙方確立「強烈競爭但不發生軍事衝突」的底線，為動盪的雙邊關係注入確定性。
在爭議議題上，習近平於閉門會談中要求美方「反對台獨」，美方對此未公開回應。雙方亦討論了中東局勢與伊朗戰爭，中國中東特使Zhai Jun表示，兩國達成的共識對緩解地區衝突至關重要。此外，中方亦承諾向亞特蘭大送交一對大貓熊。
三、 AI管控缺乏具體共識
針對快速發展的 AI 技術風險，雙方並未簽署具體約束協議。川普於會前在 Truth Social 發文表示希望讓 AI 發展「維持現狀」；習近平則在白宮致詞時強調，美中兩國有責任確保 AI 發展始終處於人類掌控之下並造福大眾。
川普週五發文談及AI的名稱，他表示，習近平似乎和幾乎所有人一樣，喜歡把他認為「命名不佳且不準確」的「人工智慧」，改稱為更準確、也更重要的「超級智慧」(super intelligence)。川普說：「那是『超級』！昨晚所有人也都同意。」
巴克萊(Barclays) 經濟學家指出，川習會談主要目的是「穩定雙邊關係」而非解決根本分歧。雖然兩國展現出維持對話與降低衝突風險的意願，但無論在貿易、AI還是地緣政治等核心議題上，均未取得實質突破。
約翰霍普金斯大學高級國際研究學院教授Ho-Fung Hung指出，兩國領導人在追求 AI 飛速成長與防止技術失控之間皆面臨兩難，導致公開聲明缺乏技術細節與實質機制。
Longview Global 資深政策分析師Dewardric McNeal亦補充，雙方在領導人層級之下，仍缺乏制度化且系統性的機制來處理這些複雜議題。
四、 盛大禮儀與媒體播映爭議
川普政府為習近平提供了極高規格接待，包括罕見親赴安德魯斯聯合基地迎接、安排三軍儀隊校閱、玫瑰園軍樂演出與戰機低空分列式。
布魯金斯學會桑頓中國中心 (John L. Thornton China Center, Brookings Institution)主任 Ryan Hass 指出，川普在外交儀式上的用心程度超過歷任前任，實質討論時間相對壓縮。
然而，由於川普日前禁止 CNN、MS NOW 及 Politico 三家媒體進入白宮新聞池，引發電視台聯合抵制，導致美方主要電視網未直播白宮軍事儀式。雖然聯邦法院緊急裁定恢復媒體採訪權，但轉播爭議仍成為峰會外的另類焦點。
paras_en: Chinese President Xi Jinping ended his three‑day visit to the United States on the 25th. This was Xi’s first official trip to Washington in eleven years, and the U.S. hosted him with lavish military honors and high‑profile diplomatic protocol. The two leaders displayed a cordial atmosphere, but the concrete agreements reached were relatively limited.

Beyond agreeing to extend the trade cease‑fire, exchanging gifts and complimentary remarks, both sides also discussed possible cooperation on managing the risks of artificial‑intelligence development. Although the highly anticipated historic summit yielded few substantive policy breakthroughs, the two countries have at least temporarily reached a consensus to stabilise the political situation amid heightened U.S.–China geopolitical tension.
The following are the four core points of the Trump‑Xi meeting:
1. Extension of the trade cease‑fire by two months

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the United States and China have agreed to extend the soon‑to‑expire trade cease‑fire agreement from November 2026 to January 10 2027. The pact, originally signed during the Busan meeting in South Korea, includes U.S. tariff reductions and a Chinese pause on export controls over rare earths and critical minerals.

Although markets had expected the extension could last up to six months, it was limited to just two months. Scott Kennedy, a senior adviser at the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), noted that the shorter extension allows the United States to retain bargaining leverage.

Equally noteworthy, unlike Trump’s earlier China trips, Xi did not bring a large corporate delegation. Cui Hongjian, an international‑relations scholar at Beijing Foreign Studies University, said this signals that the current priority in U.S.–China relations is consolidating political stability, with commercial and trade issues still frozen.
Chinese Foreign Ministry adviser Wu Xinbo also warned that some officials in the Trump team are less enthusiastic about the bilateral relationship than Trump himself.
Trump and Xi are expected to meet again at the APEC summit in Shenzhen in November and the G20 summit in Miami in December, where trade talks will continue.
The U.S. is confronting inflationary pressure, turmoil in the Middle East and the looming U.S. mid‑term elections, giving China a favorable position in a dialogue that remains “form over substance.”
2. Diplomatic rhetoric to avoid the “Thucydides Trap”

This meeting was the first face‑to‑face contact between the two leaders since their May meeting in Beijing, four months earlier. In his White House state‑dinner speech, Xi stressed that China’s rise is an opportunity for the United States, not a threat, drawing a parallel between China’s “great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation” and Trump’s “Make America Great Again” slogan, and urging joint cooperation.

In the post‑meeting press release, China noted that Xi highlighted the possibility of avoiding a “Thucydides Trap,” advocating healthy, constructive competition rather than a zero‑sum game. Hai Zhao, director of the International Politics Research Office at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences (CASS), expressed optimism about the summit atmosphere and said China was pleased with the high‑level hospitality Xi received in Washington.

Cui Shoujun, a professor at the School of International Studies, Renmin University of China, analysed that both sides set a bottom line of “intense competition without military conflict,” injecting certainty into an otherwise volatile bilateral relationship.

On contentious issues, Xi privately urged the United States to “oppose Taiwan independence,” to which the U.S. gave no public response. The two also discussed the Middle‑East situation and the Iran conflict; China’s Middle‑East envoy Zhai Jun said the consensus reached is crucial for de‑escalating regional tensions. China also pledged to send a pair of giant pandas to Atlanta.
3. AI governance lacks concrete consensus

Regarding the rapid development of AI and its risks, no binding agreement was signed. Before the summit, Trump posted on Truth Social that he hopes AI development will “stay the course”; Xi, in his White House address, stressed that the U.S. and China share responsibility to keep AI under human control and to benefit humanity.

On Friday, Trump tweeted about AI terminology, saying Xi, like many others, prefers to replace the term “artificial intelligence,” which he finds “misnamed and inaccurate,” with the more precise and important phrase “super intelligence.” Trump wrote: “That’s ‘super’! Everyone agreed last night.”

Barclays economists noted that the main purpose of the Trump‑Xi talks was to “stabilise bilateral relations” rather than resolve fundamental disagreements. While both sides showed willingness to keep dialogue open and lower conflict risk, no substantive breakthroughs were achieved on trade, AI or geopolitics.

Johns Hopkins SAIS professor Ho‑Fung Hung pointed out that the leaders face a dilemma between fostering rapid AI growth and preventing loss of control, resulting in public statements that lack technical detail or concrete mechanisms.
Dewardric McNeal, a senior policy analyst at Longview Global, added that below the leader‑level, there is still no institutionalised, systematic mechanism to handle these complex issues.
4. Grand ceremony and media‑broadcast controversy

The Trump administration provided Xi with an ultra‑high‑spec reception, including a rare personal welcome at Andrews Air Force Base, a three‑service honor guard review, a Rose Garden military band performance and low‑altitude fighter fly‑bys.

Ryan Hass, director of the John L. Thornton China Center at the Brookings Institution, said Trump’s attention to diplomatic ceremony exceeded that of his predecessors, while the substantive discussion time was comparatively compressed.

However, after Trump barred CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House press pool, the three outlets staged a joint boycott, leading major U.S. networks to skip live coverage of the White House military ceremony. Although a federal court issued an emergency order restoring media access, the broadcast dispute remained an ancillary focus of the summit.

items.title: 日元逼近160大關！日本再干預預期升溫、美元強勢成阻力
items.title_en: Yen Nearing the 160 Mark! Expectations of Further Japanese Intervention Rise as a Strong Dollar Becomes a Barrier
paras: 日元貶值壓力持續升高。即使美元兌日元匯率已突破日本先前進行匯率檢查時的水準，日元仍未止跌，9月24日一度升破159日元，隨著具有心理意義的160日元關口再次逼近，市場開始出現日本當局可能再次干預匯市的預期。
根據《日經》報導，外匯市場近日出現美元全面走強的情況，週四（24日）美元兌日元一度突破159日元。截至週六（26日），漲勢稍微回落，美元兌日元至157.30日元。
市場預期美國聯準會（Fed）最快可能在10月再次升息，加上美國長期利率走高，進一步推升美元買盤。
美東時間24日上午11時30分左右，美元兌日元約3週來首次升至159日元區間，此前一次觸及該水準是在9月2日。
日本央行在日本大型連假前曾向市場參與者詢問匯率水準，也就是所謂的「匯率檢查」，但即使匯率已突破當時約158日元前半的水準，日元貶值、美元升值的趨勢仍未扭轉。
Bannockburn Capital Markets策略師Mark Chandler表示，美國利率上升正推動美元走強。美國10年期國債殖利率24日一度升至約5.22%，創2007年6月以來最高水準。
在美國經濟數據表現穩健，以及油價上漲引發通膨可能持續更長時間的疑慮下，市場對聯準會10月再次升息的預期升溫。
根據FedWatch依美國利率期貨走勢計算的市場政策利率預期，截至美東時間24日下午，市場預估10月升息機率已升至約70%。
美元兌其他主要貨幣同樣走強。衡量美元相對主要貨幣強弱的美元指數升破101點，創7月底以來新高；歐元兌美元則一度跌至約1.1360美元，為7月下旬以來約2個月低點。
隨著美元兌日元再次逼近160日元，英國金融經紀商Trade Nation分析師David Morrison表示，7月底美日聯合干預對推升日元匯率所帶來的效果，已有相當一部分逐漸消退。他認為，不論美國是否參與，日元都再次接近可能迫使當局出手干預的水準。
不過，也有觀點認為，若由日本政府與日本央行單獨干預匯市，效果可能有限。主要原因在於，目前並非只有日元遭到投機資金集中拋售，而是美元走強本身具有較強的基本面支撐，其中包括市場對聯準會升息的預期。
三井住友日興證券資深利率及外匯策略師丸山凜途指出，若沒有美國參與聯合干預，或市場對聯準會升息的預期未明顯降溫，僅靠日本自身干預，恐難改變市場中期匯率判斷，使匯率轉向日元升值方向。
paras_en: The yen's depreciation pressure continues to rise. Even though the USD/JPY rate has broken the level examined by Japanese authorities earlier, the yen has not stopped falling, briefly climbing above ¥159 on September 24, and as the psychologically significant ¥160 threshold draws near again, the market is expecting possible renewed intervention by Japanese officials.

According to the Nikkei, the foreign‑exchange market has recently seen a broad strengthening of the dollar, with the USD/JPY briefly breaking ¥159 on Thursday (the 24th). By Saturday (the 26th) the rally had eased slightly, with the dollar at ¥157.30.
The market anticipates that the U.S. Federal Reserve could raise rates again as early as October, and rising long‑term U.S. yields are further boosting dollar buying pressure.
Around 11:30 a.m. Eastern Time on the 24th, the dollar rose to the ¥159 area for the first time in about three weeks, the previous touch of that level having been on September 2.

Before Japan’s major holiday, the Bank of Japan conducted a “rate check” by polling market participants, but even after the exchange rate passed the mid‑¥158 level at that time, the yen’s decline and the dollar’s rise have not reversed.

Bannockburn Capital Markets strategist Mark Chandler said rising U.S. rates are driving a stronger dollar. The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield briefly hit about 5.22% on the 24th, the highest since June 2007.
With solid U.S. economic data and oil‑price‑driven inflation concerns lingering, expectations that the Fed will raise rates again in October have heated up.
Based on FedWatch’s calculation from U.S. rate‑futures, the market’s probability of an October hike rose to roughly 70% by the afternoon of the 24th Eastern Time.

The dollar is also strengthening against other major currencies. The dollar index, which measures the greenback’s strength versus a basket of peers, broke the 101‑point mark, a high not seen since late July; the euro slipped to about $1.1360, its lowest in roughly two months since late July.

As the dollar again approaches ¥160, Trade Nation analyst David Morrison said the impact of the late‑July US‑Japan joint intervention on lifting the yen has largely faded. He believes that, regardless of U.S. participation, the yen is once more near a level that could force authorities to step in.

However, some view that a solo intervention by the Japanese government and the Bank of Japan would have limited effect. The main reason is that it is not only the yen that is being sold by speculators; the dollar’s strength is underpinned by solid fundamentals, including market expectations of further Fed hikes.

Mitsui Sumitomo Nomura senior rates and FX strategist Rintaro Maruyama warned that without U.S. participation in a joint intervention, or without a clear cooling of Fed‑rate expectations, Japan acting alone is unlikely to shift medium‑term market sentiment toward yen appreciation.

items.title: 美元「死亡交叉」逼近 川普可能樂見其成？
items.title_en: Dollar "Death Cross" Nearing; Trump May Welcome It?
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，目前確實有一些技術面因素，讓人相信美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)向金融市場宣告「現在我是莊家了」可能有其道理。
不僅美元的上行動能似乎已轉向日元，美元則失去優勢。同時，一個令人警戒、被稱為「死亡交叉」的技術型態正在形成，預計下周初就會確認。這意味著美元兌日元先前快速上升的趨勢可能已經反轉，而這波漲勢不僅威脅日本經濟，也不受川普政府歡迎。
死亡交叉未必是精準的市場進出訊號，但有助於強化「新趨勢可能已經形成」的觀點。Oppenheimer & Co.技術分析主管Ari Wald表示，「我們喜歡說，每一次重大的下跌走勢都始於死亡交叉，但並非每一次死亡交叉都會導致大幅下跌。」
美元兌日元周五午盤下跌1%，朝近3周來最大單日跌幅邁進。貝森特則在X平台發文，談及川普支持「強勢日元的理想性」，這也是日本銀行一直推動的方向。這波拋售出現在技術線型的關鍵時刻，進一步證明持續17個月的上升趨勢可能已經遭突破。隨著日元兌美元升值，美元兌日元匯率便會下跌。
當政府告訴投資人不要再買進某項資產時，市場有時反而會產生一種近乎反抗的興趣，選擇反其道而行，因為這可能讓人認為，當局之所以出手，是相信漲勢仍會持續，除非政府直接進場干預市場。
歷史上也有許多政府干預最終未能阻止市場走勢的案例，甚至出現極為戲劇性的結果，例如1992年英鎊崩盤、1990年代末的亞洲金融危機，以及貝森特近期試圖壓低長天期美國公債殖利率升勢的行動。
因此，當美國財政部與日本銀行在7月底合作，試圖阻止美元兌日元匯率持續攀升時，許多人認為，雖然匯率可能先行下跌，但推動匯率升至當前水準的基本面因素仍會重新發揮作用，價格很快就會恢復原本的上升軌道。
但在短暫走強後，美元兌日元匯率於9月3日跌破一條追蹤2025年4月低點以來漲勢的趨勢線。買方再度進場，推動匯率回升並測試該趨勢線，以確認這是否真的代表突破。周五的拋售則確認了這項突破。
而這波拋售發生在美元兌日元試圖重新站回200日移動均線之後。許多技術分析人士將200日移動均線視為區分長期上升趨勢與下降趨勢的重要界線。
Wald寫道，「今天在200日移動均線遭遇失敗，使該貨幣對面臨測試152支撐位的風險，該位置接近2026年的低點。」
接下來就是死亡交叉。
當50日移動均線向下穿越200日移動均線時，就會形成死亡交叉。這通常被視為短期跌勢進一步轉變為長期下降趨勢的訊號。
根據目前美元兌日元50日與200日移動均線的走勢，兩條均線預計將在下周結束前交叉。這將是該貨幣對自2025年3月25日以來首次出現死亡交叉。
上一次出現死亡交叉後，價格又下跌6%，約一個月後才觸底。
不過，再前一次死亡交叉出現在2024年9月9日，價格僅再下跌1.8%，一周後便觸底。
儘管如此，Oppenheimer的Wald認為，在目前的技術面結構下，死亡交叉「與動能全面減弱的情況一致」，並且「進一步強化了趨勢反轉的可能性」。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that there are indeed some technical factors that make it plausible that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s declaration to the markets “I am now the house” could have some merit.

Not only has the dollar's upward momentum apparently shifted to the yen, leaving the dollar at a disadvantage, but a warning‑sign technical pattern known as a “death cross” is forming and is expected to be confirmed early next week. This suggests that the dollar‑yen’s recent rapid rise may have already reversed, a rally that threatens the Japanese economy and is not welcomed by the Trump administration.

A death cross is not necessarily a precise market entry or exit signal, but it helps reinforce the view that a “new trend may have formed.” Ari Wald, head of technical analysis at Oppenheimer & Co., said, “We like to say that every major downtrend starts with a death cross, but not every death cross leads to a big drop.”

The dollar fell 1% against the yen at the Friday midday session, moving toward its biggest single‑day decline in nearly three weeks. Bessent posted on X, noting Trump’s support for a “strong yen,” which aligns with the Bank of Japan’s long‑standing policy. The sell‑off came at a critical technical juncture, further proving that the 17‑month uptrend may have been broken. As the yen appreciates versus the dollar, the USD/JPY rate falls.

When a government tells investors not to buy a certain asset, the market sometimes reacts with a near‑rebellious interest, choosing to go the opposite way because it may be interpreted that authorities intervene only because they still believe the rally will continue, unless they step in directly.

History is full of cases where government intervention failed to stop market moves, sometimes with dramatic outcomes, such as the 1992 British pound crash, the late‑1990s Asian financial crisis, and Bessent’s recent attempts to curb the rise in long‑term U.S. Treasury yields.

Thus, when the U.S. Treasury and the Bank of Japan cooperated at the end of July to try to halt the USD/JPY rise, many believed that although the rate might dip first, the fundamental drivers that pushed it to current levels would soon reassert themselves and the price would quickly resume its upward path.

After a brief rally, the USD/JPY rate broke below a trend line that has been tracking the rise since the low of April 2025 on September 3. Buyers re‑entered, pushing the rate back up to test that line to confirm whether it truly represented a breakout. Friday’s sell‑off confirmed the breakout.

The sell‑off occurred after the dollar‑yen tried to retake the 200‑day moving average. Many technical analysts view the 200‑day moving average as a key boundary separating long‑term uptrends from downtrends.
Wald wrote, “Today the 200‑day moving average failed, exposing the pair to a test of the 152 support level, which is near the 2026 low.”
Next comes the death cross.
When the 50‑day moving average crosses below the 200‑day moving average, a death cross forms. This is usually seen as a signal that a short‑term decline is turning into a longer‑term downtrend.

Based on the current paths of the 50‑day and 200‑day moving averages for USD/JPY, the two lines are expected to cross before the end of next week, marking the first death cross for the pair since March 25, 2025.
The previous death cross was followed by a 6% price drop, with the bottom reached about a month later.
The earlier death cross on September 9, 2024, saw only a 1.8% decline, with the bottom hit a week later.

Nevertheless, Wald of Oppenheimer believes that, given the current technical structure, the death cross “aligns with a comprehensive weakening of momentum” and “further strengthens the possibility of a trend reversal.”

items.title: Meta近期漲勢只是「開始」？「這一關鍵價格」成關鍵、華爾街目標價最高喊995美元
items.title_en: Meta's Recent Rally Is Just the 'Beginning'? This Key Price Level Is Crucial, Wall Street's Highest Target at $995
paras: Meta(META-US) 旗下人工智慧（AI）產品Muse近期引發市場關注，推動Meta股價本週大幅上漲。隨著華爾街分析師陸續調高目標價，市場也開始關注Meta能否突破800美元關卡。分析認為，若能站上該關卡，近期這波漲勢可能只是開始。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，Meta股價週五（25日）收跌3.33%，收在751.66美元，前一交易日則大漲4.5%。儘管週五走弱，但根據道瓊斯市場數據，Meta本週累計仍上漲近13%，有望創下逾13年來最佳單月表現。
Muse成為這波漲勢的重要推手。Meta及部分分析師認為，Muse可能是OpenAI推出ChatGPT以來最重要的AI產品之一。
Meta隨後在Connect主題演講中進一步介紹相關產品，而隨著市場認為Meta股價的上漲空間更加可觀，華爾街也持續密集上調目標價。
Meta本月股價雖然明顯走高，但仍未能站上800美元。週五收盤價較2025年8月12日創下的790美元歷史收盤高點低約5%。
從技術走勢來看，Meta股價過去逾1年大致維持在約600美元至790多美元的區間內震盪。若股價能突破這一區間並站上800美元，近期由Muse帶動的漲勢可能進一步延續。
華爾街近期調漲目標價的舉動也印證了這個觀點。
Canaccord Genuity分析師Maria Ripps將Meta目標價從930美元上調至950美元，以週五（25日）收盤價751.66美元計算，代表仍有約26%的上漲空間，同時維持「買進」評級。
Ripps在研究報告中表示，其預期隨著Muse證明Meta的模型與基礎設施支出能夠支撐一項可透過訂閱收入、並隨時間推進進一步從交易手續費獲利的產品，同時廣告收入仍可作為額外選項，Meta股價的評價將持續上修。
該分析師指出，Meta旗下各項App擁有廣泛用戶觸及，加上廣告業務能長期支撐免費AI代理，讓Meta有空間維持Muse較低的使用費用；相較之下，獨立AI開發商可能更早面臨讓AI代理實現營收的壓力。
Ripps並非唯一持此看法的分析師。TD Cowen分析師John Blackledge週五也將Meta目標價從750美元上調至865美元。
Blackledge在研究報告中表示，隨著Muse推出，Meta的AI生態系統已逐漸成形。他同時看好Meta為Muse提供的硬體布局，以及Connect活動公布的產品推出時程。
他預估，Muse全球營收可能從2026年的5,500萬美元，大幅增加至2027年的18億美元，並在2030年達到270億美元，屆時約占Meta總營收6%。
德意志銀行分析師Benjamin Black同樣認為，Meta股價有機會突破800美元並進一步走高。他週五將目標價從750美元調高至820美元。
Black指出，Meta目前似乎主要著眼於為Muse建立龐大的用戶基礎，再尋求未來將其商業化；此外，Meta最終可能依據資料使用量推出不同的訂閱方案。
近期也有分析師給出更高的目標價。Tigress Financial Partners分析師Ivan Feinseth將Meta目標價從945美元上調至995美元，認為Muse可能改變Meta在消費者市場中的角色。
Feinseth表示，如果用戶將Muse納入日常使用習慣，Meta除了廣告業務之外，還可能從訂閱與電子商務取得收入。
不過，他也指出，這些商業機會的財務規模目前仍有待確立，而Muse代表Meta能向全球用戶網路提供的服務範圍進一步擴大。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) has seen its AI product Muse draw market attention recently, driving Meta's stock sharply higher this week. As Wall Street analysts gradually raise their price targets, the market is also watching whether Meta can break the $800 barrier. Analysts say that if it can clear that level, the current rally may only be the start.

According to Barron's, Meta's shares closed Friday (the 25th) down 3.33% at $751.66, after a 4.5% jump the previous trading day. Despite Friday's weakness, Dow Jones market data shows Meta is still up nearly 13% for the week, poised to post its best monthly performance in over 13 years.
Muse has become a key driver of this rally. Meta and some analysts believe Muse could be one of the most important AI products since OpenAI launched ChatGPT.
Meta later provided further details on the product during its Connect keynote, and as the market sees more upside potential for the stock, Wall Street continues to lift its price targets.
Although Meta's share price has risen noticeably this month, it has yet to break $800. Friday's closing price was about 5% below the historic high of $790 set on August 12, 2025.

From a technical perspective, Meta's stock has traded in a range of roughly $600 to just over $790 for more than a year. If the price can break out of that range and stay above $800, the Muse‑driven rally could continue.
Wall Street's recent target‑raising actions also support this view.
Canaccord Genuity analyst Maria Ripps raised Meta's price target from $930 to $950, which, based on Friday's close of $751.66, implies about 26% upside and she maintains a "Buy" rating.

Ripps said in her research report that she expects Meta's valuation to keep climbing as Muse proves the company's model and infrastructure spending can support a subscription‑based product that also generates transaction‑fee revenue over time, while ad revenue remains an additional option.

The analyst noted that Meta's suite of apps reaches a broad user base, and its advertising business can sustainably support a low‑cost AI agent, giving Meta room to keep Muse's usage fees modest; by contrast, independent AI developers may face pressure to monetize their agents sooner.
Ripps is not the only analyst sharing this view. TD Cowen analyst John Blackledge also raised Meta's target on Friday, moving it from $750 to $865.
Blackledge wrote that with Muse's launch, Meta's AI ecosystem is beginning to take shape. He is also bullish on Meta's hardware roadmap for Muse and the product rollout timeline announced at Connect.
He estimates Muse's global revenue could grow from $55 million in 2026 to $1.8 billion in 2027, reaching $27 billion by 2030, roughly 6% of Meta's total revenue at that point.
Deutsche Bank analyst Benjamin Black likewise sees the stock having a chance to break $800 and move higher. He lifted his target on Friday from $750 to $820.

Black pointed out that Meta appears focused on building a large user base for Muse before seeking to commercialize it, and that the company may eventually offer different subscription tiers based on data usage.
Some analysts have even higher targets. Tigress Financial Partners analyst Ivan Feinseth raised Meta's target from $945 to $995, believing Muse could reshape Meta's role in the consumer market.
Feinseth said that if users adopt Muse into their daily routines, Meta could generate revenue not only from ads but also from subscriptions and e‑commerce.

However, he cautioned that the financial scale of these opportunities is still uncertain, and that Muse represents Meta's ability to expand the range of services it can offer to its global user network.

Foreign investors net bought over NT$100 billion of Taiwanese stocks and heavily purchased active ETFs, lifting the total assets of active ETFs back to the trillion‑NTD level. Moreover, foreign investors bought the fund net for five consecutive trading days, totaling 338,400 shares, indicating strong foreign interest in its performance.

00403A has been the most aggressively bought listed stock by foreign investors recently, recording net purchases for seven straight trading days amounting to 674,200 shares. As trading enthusiasm heats up, 00403A has also topped the active‑ETF trading‑volume chart for five consecutive days, reflecting its market popularity.

Looking ahead, Uni‑Invest’s research team notes that while short‑term Taiwan market sentiment remains constrained by higher U.S. Treasury yields, global liquidity tightening and geopolitical risks, the market is expected to stay in a high‑level range. Benefiting from continued AI application expansion, strong export demand and corporate earnings, fundamentals should support the market. As uncertainties around the U.S. mid‑term elections and rate policy fade, Q4 still offers chances to challenge previous highs. The team will keep watching growth sectors such as AI ASICs, advanced packaging, optical communications and memory.

items.title: 新漢前進美國台灣形象展 展出六大關鍵場域AIoT落地應用
items.title_en: Xinhang Advances at the Taiwan Image Expo in the United States, Showcasing Six Key AIoT Application Areas
paras: 工業電腦廠新漢(8234-TW)持續以軟硬體整合及功能安全技術為核心，推進Edge AI應用落地，受邀參加本周於美國達拉斯舉行的美國台灣形象展（TAIWAN EXPO USA 2026），展出六大AIoT Solutions落地方案。
此次新漢展出內容涵蓋旗下創博MARS Pro系列機器人控制平台、智慧工廠AI生產應用、工業級OT資安防護eSAF系統、企業級EdgeGPT AI-X及智慧城市NDiS系列等方案，展示集團在Edge AI、工業自動化及AIoT領域的整合能力。
新漢表示，此次藉由參展深化北美當地產業鏈結，將長期深耕的AI邊緣運算與工業自動化軟硬實力跨足北美，持續推動相關軟硬體解決方案落地，拓展海外市場商機。
在機器人布局方面，新漢旗下專注於機器人控制與運動控制的子公司創博，於8月台北國際自動化工業大展宣布攜手工研院、仁寶、德國Synapticon及數十家國內外關鍵零組件夥伴，成立「RoboWIZ AI機器人開放平台」。
新漢指出，RoboWIZ AI機器人生態系在國內自動化展亮相後，本次進一步於達拉斯展出，也是擴大全球生態系布局的重要一環，未來將鎖定歐美市場需求，尋找潛力技術及通路合作夥伴，擴大AI機器人相關合作機會。
RoboWIZ AI機器人開放平台涵蓋AI核心控制、功能安全與資安、視覺感知、實時控制及致動整機等五大架構，藉由開放平台降低跨領域整合門檻，加速人形、四足及雙臂機器人的產業落地。
董事長林茂昌表示，集團機器人業務相關產品詢問度與出貨力道持續增溫，隨著RoboWIZ AI機器人生態系持續擴張，加上歐美市場深化推廣，成為推升今年第四季及中長期營運成長的核心動能。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Xinhang (8234-TW) continues to focus on integrated hardware‑software and functional safety technologies to drive Edge AI deployments, and was invited to participate in this week’s Taiwan Image Expo in Dallas, USA (TAIWAN EXPO USA 2026), where it displayed six AIoT solution implementations.

The exhibition featured Xinhang’s Chuangbo MARS Pro series robot control platform, smart‑factory AI production applications, industrial‑grade OT cybersecurity eSAF system, enterprise‑level EdgeGPT AI‑X, and the smart‑city NDiS series, demonstrating the group’s integration capabilities in Edge AI, industrial automation and AIoT.

Xinhang said the show deepens its North‑American supply‑chain connections, allowing its long‑standing AI edge‑computing and industrial‑automation hardware‑software expertise to enter the North American market, continue rolling out related solutions, and expand overseas business opportunities.

In the robotics arena, Xinhang’s subsidiary Chuangbo, which focuses on robot and motion control, announced at the August Taipei International Automation Industry Exhibition that it has partnered with the Industrial Technology Research Institute, Compal, Germany’s Synapticon and dozens of key component partners worldwide to launch the “RoboWIZ AI Robot Open Platform.”

Xinhang noted that after the RoboWIZ AI robot ecosystem was showcased at the domestic automation expo, its appearance at the Dallas show is another step in expanding the global ecosystem, with future plans to target European and American market demand, seek promising technologies and channel partners, and broaden AI‑robot collaboration opportunities.

The RoboWIZ AI Robot Open Platform comprises five major layers: AI core control, functional safety and cybersecurity, visual perception, real‑time control, and the complete actuator system, using an open platform to lower cross‑disciplinary integration barriers and accelerate the deployment of humanoid, quadruped and dual‑arm robots.

Chairman Lin Mao‑chang said inquiries and shipments for the group’s robot‑related products continue to rise. As the RoboWIZ AI robot ecosystem expands and promotion deepens in Europe and the United States, it will become a core driver for growth in the fourth quarter and the medium‑to‑long‑term operating performance.

items.title_en: AI National Team Takes Action! National Development Council Leads Delegation to Microsoft and Stanford, Focusing on Compute Deployment, Startup Links, and Talent Transformation
paras: 為加速推動我國「AI新十大建設」，國發會主委葉俊顯、數發部次長楊佳玲與工研院董事長吳政忠率領產官學研代表團，邀集生物技術開發中心執行長李財坤、中央研究院、國內六所頂尖大學以及台灣玉山科技協會等代表，於 9 月共同展開訪美行程。代表團一行深入走訪微軟（Microsoft）等國際科技巨擘、史丹佛大學知名加速器 StartX，以及加州大學柏克萊分校（UC Berkeley）等前沿機構，針對 AI 算力部署、主權 AI 建置、新創國際化拓展、預防醫學與數位健康等核心議題展開深度對接，其中又以人才培育與新創發展為各場次交流的共同重中之重。

聚焦主權 AI 與算力韌性 借鏡國際經驗推動百工百業轉型

在此次產業參訪中，我方代表團向美方機構詳細說明台灣「AI新十大建設」推動方案，並就建立我國主權 AI（Sovereign AI）、強化算力韌性，以及企業人才培訓等議題展開深入研討。交流內容涵蓋各國主權 AI 的建置架構、資料主權（Data Sovereignty）保障機制，以及多元 AI 大模型的靈活運用。代表團亦參考國際示範案例與在地生態系建置經驗，探討如何協助國內中小微企業有效導入 AI 技術，進而帶動「百工百業」轉型升級；同時藉由汲取國際科技大廠與國外政府的公私合作（PPP）模式，為我國未來政策規劃提供重要依據。

在人才培育與新創發展方面，國際業者特別強調，推動 AI 產業應用必須同步提升企業管理層及員工的數位技術能力，雙方並深入探討國際人才認證與我國「AI 人才指引」的無縫銜接機制。此外，StartX 及 UC Berkeley 亦分享了成熟的人才與新創培育體系，力助台灣新創團隊吸收國際實戰經驗、扎根在地生態系，進一步加速拓展美國市場。國發會強調，未來將持續整合產官學研及國際夥伴資源，全力強化人才培育與新創鏈結，厚植台灣 AI 發展的長遠能量。

鏈結 Stanford StartX 校友社群 打造 Startup Island TAIWAN 獨角獸搖籃

考慮到台灣新創團隊前往美國發展時，極需融入當地的創新創業社群，本次訪美特別安排前往參訪 Stanford StartX 加速器，深入剖析其如何透過獨特的校友社群營運模式，成功培育出 29 家獨角獸企業（Unicorns）的寶貴經驗。雙方並就建立 StartX 與台灣新創社群之間的雙向交流合作機制充分交換意見。

參訪期間，StartX 特別安排 3 家同時身兼 Startup Island TAIWAN 矽谷基地會員與 StartX 社群成員的台灣新創代表分享發展現況。國發會表示，未來將透過跨部會協同合作，選送更多優質新創團隊至 StartX 進行深度培育，協助台灣新創藉由融入美國在地社群打開國際知名度；同時也將仿效 StartX 的經驗，建立 Startup Island TAIWAN 專屬校友社群，培育更多能在國際舞台發光發熱的優秀新創。

半導體與 ICT 廠優勢結合 UC Berkeley AI 演算法 搶攻智慧醫療藍海

國發會近年積極推動台灣創新創業生態系鏈結全球頂尖科研聚落，多年來已與 UC Berkeley 公共衛生學院（SPH）建立緊密的生醫加速器計畫合作關係。本次訪美除公衛學院外，更擴大邀請該校創新與創業學院、工學院及商學院教授一同參與，針對「個人化醫療」與「醫療 AI 創新應用」展開跨領域對談。
會中聚焦全球醫療趨勢正從傳統「疾病治療」加速轉向「普及且具韌性的日常健康照護」，雙方深入探討如何結合台灣半導體與 ICT 製造業既有的堅實優勢，攜手打造下一世代智慧醫療生態系。此舉期能持續深化台美新創商業化與國際市場拓展機制，進一步促進台灣業者在消費性電子與精密製造上的硬體強項，與 UC Berkeley 頂尖 AI 演算法技術進行跨域融合，共同開拓龐大的全球市場商機。
國發會總結指出，本次訪美行成功鏈結國際科技大廠、頂尖學術機構與新創生態系，不僅深化了我國在主權 AI、算力建設、人才培育、新創國際化以及智慧醫療等關鍵領域的跨國合作，更為國內產業開創了全新的國際連結管道。展望未來，政府將持續串聯產官學研與國際夥伴資源，強化跨域技術整合與商業化落地機制，全力帶領台灣新創與科技產業大步邁向全球市場，進一步厚植台灣 AI 產業與創新經濟的永續動能。
paras_en: To accelerate Taiwan's "AI New Ten Major Projects," the National Development Council (NDC) Chairman Ye Junxian, Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Digital Affairs Yang Jialing, and Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) President Wu Zhengzhong led a delegation of industry, government, academia, and research representatives. The group, which included the CEO of the Biotechnology Development Center Li Caikun, representatives from Academia Sinica, six top domestic universities, and the Taiwan Yushan Technology Association, began a U.S. visit on September 9. The delegation visited international tech giants such as Microsoft, the renowned Stanford accelerator StartX, and the University of California, Berkeley, engaging in in‑depth discussions on AI compute deployment, sovereign AI construction, startup internationalization, preventive medicine, and digital health, with talent cultivation and startup development highlighted in every session.

During the industry visits, our delegation detailed Taiwan's "AI New Ten Major Projects" plan to U.S. institutions and held extensive talks on building sovereign AI, strengthening compute resilience, and corporate talent training. The exchanges covered sovereign AI architectures, data‑sovereignty safeguards, and flexible use of diverse large AI models. The team also examined international case studies and local ecosystem experiences to explore how to help Taiwanese SMEs adopt AI technology, driving transformation across all sectors, and drew lessons from public‑private partnership (PPP) models of global tech giants and foreign governments to inform future policy planning.

Regarding talent cultivation and startup development, international partners stressed that advancing AI applications must be accompanied by upskilling both management and staff in digital technologies. Both sides discussed seamless alignment between international talent certifications and Taiwan's "AI Talent Guidelines." StartX and UC Berkeley also shared mature talent and startup incubation systems to help Taiwanese startups gain practical international experience, embed themselves in the local ecosystem, and accelerate entry into the U.S. market. The NDC emphasized that it will continue to integrate resources from industry, government, academia, research, and international partners to strengthen talent development and startup linkages, building long‑term capacity for Taiwan's AI growth.

Linking the Stanford StartX alumni community, the delegation aimed to create a "Startup Island TAIWAN" unicorn cradle. Recognizing that Taiwanese startups need to integrate into U.S. innovation circles, the visit included a tour of the Stanford StartX accelerator to dissect how its unique alumni network has nurtured 29 unicorn companies. Both sides exchanged ideas on establishing a two‑way exchange and cooperation mechanism between StartX and Taiwan's startup community.

During the visit, StartX arranged for three Taiwanese startups—simultaneously members of the Startup Island TAIWAN Silicon Valley base and the StartX community—to share their progress. The NDC said it will, through cross‑agency collaboration, select more high‑quality Taiwanese startups for deep incubation at StartX, helping them gain international visibility by embedding in U.S. local networks. It also plans to emulate StartX's model to build a dedicated Startup Island TAIWAN alumni community, cultivating more startups that can shine on the global stage.

Combining Taiwan's semiconductor and ICT strengths with UC Berkeley AI algorithms to capture the smart‑health blue ocean, the NDC has long promoted connections between Taiwan's innovation ecosystem and top global research hubs. It has maintained a close biomedical accelerator partnership with UC Berkeley's School of Public Health (SPH). This U.S. trip expanded the collaboration to include faculty from the university's Innovation and Entrepreneurship, Engineering, and Business schools for cross‑disciplinary dialogue on personalized medicine and medical AI innovation.

The meeting highlighted a global shift in healthcare from traditional disease treatment toward ubiquitous, resilient daily health care. Both sides explored how to leverage Taiwan's solid semiconductor and ICT manufacturing base to co‑create the next‑generation smart‑health ecosystem. The initiative aims to deepen Taiwan‑U.S. startup commercialization and market expansion mechanisms, further promoting Taiwan's hardware strengths in consumer electronics and precision manufacturing alongside UC Berkeley's cutting‑edge AI algorithms, jointly tapping massive global market opportunities.

In summary, the U.S. visit successfully linked international tech giants, leading academic institutions, and the startup ecosystem, deepening cross‑border cooperation for Taiwan in sovereign AI, compute infrastructure, talent development, startup internationalization, and smart health. Looking ahead, the government will continue to connect industry, government, academia, research, and international partners, strengthening cross‑domain technology integration and commercialization pathways, driving Taiwanese startups and the tech sector toward the global market and sustainably powering Taiwan's AI industry and innovative economy.

items.title: 精華生醫擬10/15上櫃掛牌 膳食補充劑市場商機放大中
items.title_en: Jinghua Biotech Plans OTC Listing on Oct. 15 as Dietary Supplement Market Expands
paras: 全球膳食補充劑市場商機放大之中，食品類股精華生醫(7806-TW) 擬於10月15日以每股55元掛牌，配合上櫃前公開承銷，對外競價拍賣2040張，競拍時間為9月29日至10月1日，競拍底價42.31元，暫定每股承銷價55元。10月2日至6日辦理公開申購，10月8日抽籤，預計在10月15日掛牌。
人體及寵物保健食品開發商騰勢 (7889-TW) 營運成長中，其上櫃申請案再過一關，昨(24)日並獲OTC董監聯席會通過，騰勢最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收6967萬元，月減5.49%，年減1.36%，2026年1-8月營收6.02億元，年增10.61%。目前股本2.07億元的騰勢，在2026年1-6月財報顯示，上半年稅後純益4587萬元，每股純益2.24元。
保健食品CDMO廠精華生醫近年營運快速放大，營收自2022年的1.39億元成長至2023年4.04億元、2024年4.35億元、2025年再以5.39億元創歷史新高，2023年-2025年年營收成長率約15.5%；2026年前8個月營收3.72億元與去年同期小幅成長，在高基期下維持穩健營運軌道。
精華生醫透過配方研發與產品組合優化維持獲利品質，精華生醫2025年毛利率達30.40%，稅後淨利7,533.2萬元創歷史新高，純益率13.99%，EPS 3.04元；2026年上半年因新產品的測試成本及一次性上櫃作業費用的認列，致毛利率及純益率分別為26.65%及10.05%，每股純益為0.97元。
精華生醫成立以來對於產品秉持「有效、均一、安全」的最高品質標準、相較同業更早聚集於利基型漢方保健產品及採CDMO接單的客戶占比提高，市場預期未來公司的營收及獲利仍會穩定成長。
精華生醫董事長陳俊宏表示，精華生醫已布局16項國內外專利（含申請中），涵蓋萃取製程設備、劑型輸送系統與機能性複方配方，並擁有思倍聰、筋活源、潤肌源、蔓舒妍、甘衡寶五大專利配方，以及技轉自台灣大學的LM護腎益生菌（PRen+），可協助品牌客戶建立產品獨特性與市場排他性，跳脫同質化競爭。
此外，精華生醫已取得衛福部「調節血脂」及「調節血糖」2張健康食品認證，並與台灣大學、南台科技大學、嘉南藥理大學、食品工業發展研究所、農業科技研究院及高雄科技大學建立產學合作網絡，從原料研究、功效驗證到商品化形成完整研發鏈，有助拉高保健食品代工的進入門檻。
根據Precedence Research資料指出，全球膳食補充劑市場規模2025年約2034.2億美元，預估2035年將達4303.9億美元，2026年至2035年年複合成長率達7.78%，產品涵蓋膠囊、錠劑、軟膠囊、液劑與粉末等多元劑型。隨全球健康意識與產品差異化需求持續升溫，法人看好具備配方研發、專利原料、官方認證及多劑型製造能力的CDMO業者，可望在產業擴張過程中取得更高附加價值。
paras_en: The global dietary supplement market is expanding, and food sector stock Jinghua Biotech (7806‑TW) intends to list on October 15 at NT$55 per share. In conjunction with the pre‑listing public offering, 2,040 shares will be auctioned publicly from September 29 to October 1, with a floor price of NT$42.31 and a provisional underwriting price of NT$55 per share. Public subscription will run from October 2 to 6, a lottery will be held on October 8, and the listing is expected on October 15.

Pet and human health‑food developer Tengshi (7889‑TW) continues to grow. Its OTC listing application cleared another hurdle when the OTC Board of Directors and Supervisors approved it on the 24th. Tengshi’s latest revenue figures show NT$69.67 million for August 2026, a 5.49% month‑over‑month decline and a 1.36% year‑over‑year decline. Revenue for January‑August 2026 was NT$602 million, up 10.61% YoY. With a capital of NT$2.07 billion, Tengshi reported a net profit after tax of NT$45.87 million for the first half of 2026, or NT$2.24 earnings per share.

Jinghua Biotech, a CDMO for health‑food products, has seen rapid operational expansion in recent years. Revenue grew from NT$139 million in 2022 to NT$404 million in 2023, NT$435 million in 2024, and reached a record NT$539 million in 2025, reflecting an average annual growth rate of about 15.5% from 2023‑2025. For the first eight months of 2026, revenue was NT$372 million, a modest increase over the same period last year, indicating steady performance despite a high base.

Through formula development and product‑mix optimization, Jinghua Biotech maintained profit quality. In 2025 its gross margin hit 30.40%, net profit after tax reached a record NT$75.332 million, yielding a net profit margin of 13.99% and EPS of NT$3.04. In the first half of 2026, testing costs for new products and one‑time listing expenses lowered gross margin to 26.65% and net profit margin to 10.05%, with earnings of NT$0.97 per share.

Since its founding, Jinghua Biotech has adhered to the highest quality standards of “effective, uniform, safe” for its products. Compared with peers, it entered the niche herbal‑health segment earlier and increased the proportion of CDMO‑contract customers, leading market expectations that its revenue and profit will continue to grow steadily.

Chairman Chen Jun‑hong said Jinghua Biotech has built a portfolio of 16 domestic and international patents (including pending applications) covering extraction equipment, dosage‑form delivery systems, and functional compound formulas. The company holds five key patented formulas—Si Bei Cong, Jin Huo Yuan, Run Ji Yuan, Man Shu Yan, and Gan Heng Bao—as well as a technology‑transferred LM kidney‑protective probiotic (PRen+) from National Taiwan University, which can help brand customers create product uniqueness and market exclusivity, breaking away from commoditized competition.

In addition, Jinghua Biotech has obtained two health‑food certifications from the Ministry of Health and Welfare for “blood‑lipid regulation” and “blood‑sugar regulation.” It has also established industry‑academia collaboration networks with National Taiwan University, Southern Taiwan University of Science and Technology, Chia‑Nan University of Pharmacy and Science, the Food Industry Development Research Institute, the Agricultural Technology Research Institute, and Kaohsiung University of Science and Technology, forming a complete R&D chain from raw‑material research and efficacy verification to commercialization, which raises the entry barrier for health‑food contract manufacturing.

According to Precedence Research, the global dietary supplement market size is projected to be about US$203.42 billion in 2025 and to reach US$430.39 billion by 2035, with a compound annual growth rate of 7.78% from 2026 to 2035. Products span capsules, tablets, soft‑gels, liquids, and powders. As global health awareness and demand for differentiated products rise, institutional investors are optimistic about CDMO firms that possess formula R&D, patented ingredients, official certifications, and multi‑dosage‑form manufacturing capabilities, expecting them to capture higher added value as the industry expands.

items.title: 北台灣新地標在林口 東森與晶華打團體戰讓桃園成全新大本營
items.title_en: New Northern Taiwan Landmark in Linkou: ETT and Regent Team Up to Make Taoyuan a Fresh Headquarters
paras: 北台灣新地標東森恩典大樓(Grace Tower)將於12月底揭幕，東森集團最新指出，旗下東森恩典大樓一口氣將商務、餐旅、會員經濟和生活周邊服務納入，除了備受矚目的「450台灣之眼」景觀空間，也攜手晶華(2707-TW)導入飯店和多家人氣餐飲品牌，林口正在成為東森集團和晶華酒店最新發展的大本營。
東森集團將恩典大樓設定為全球營運總部發展，投入建造資金高達190億元，目標串聯起旗下健康、美業、媒體、線上線下和會員經濟，並導入AI應用新技術。
除了自家的多元事業在總部串聯，東森更找來強力合作夥伴晶華共同打團體戰，樓內開出晶英酒店，以及台北晶華館內的人氣餐廳包括米其林餐飲品牌晶華軒、三燔和Robin’s牛排等。
東森表示，總部內還提供有國際會議中心、健康休閒，滿足住宿、餐飲和商務接待機能。
目前東森恩典大樓主體輪廓逐漸成形，建築高度約199公尺，加上林口台地約253公尺，形成海拔超過450公尺的高空景觀視野，開車南下行經國道1號林口交流道或五楊高架時，已可清楚看見醒目的白色高樓矗立於林口台地，成北台灣城市天際線的新座標。
東森恩典大樓往來交通便捷，位於機場捷運A9林口站旁，步行約3分鐘即可抵達，同時鄰近國道1號林口交流道，可快速串聯台北都會區和桃園國際機場，而周邊有三井OUTLET等商業設施，生活圈更涵蓋林口長庚醫院及周邊醫療、商務與休閒機能，具備企業總部、商務接待和旅遊休閒所需的便利條件。
paras_en: A new landmark in northern Taiwan, the ETT Grace Tower, is set to be unveiled at the end of December. ETT Group announced that the Grace Tower will integrate business, hospitality, membership economy, and lifestyle services. In addition to the highly anticipated "450 Taiwan Eye" observation space, it will partner with Regent (2707‑TW) to bring in a hotel and several popular dining brands, turning Linkou into the latest development hub for ETT Group and Regent Hotels.

ETT Group has designated the Grace Tower as its global operations headquarters, investing up to NT$19 billion in construction. The goal is to link its health, beauty, media, online‑offline, and membership businesses, and to incorporate new AI technologies.

Beyond consolidating its diversified businesses at the headquarters, ETT has teamed up with strong partner Regent for a joint venture. The building will host the Regent Hotel, as well as popular restaurants from Regent’s Taipei venue, including the Michelin‑rated Regent Xuan, San Fan, and Robin’s Steakhouse.
ETT says the headquarters will also feature an international conference center and wellness facilities, meeting the needs for accommodation, dining, and business reception.

The main structure of the Grace Tower is now taking shape, standing about 199 metres tall. Combined with Linkou’s plateau elevation of roughly 253 metres, the site offers a sky‑high view exceeding 450 metres above sea level. Driving south on National Highway 1 at the Linkou interchange or on the Wuyang elevated road, the striking white tower is clearly visible, becoming a new coordinate on northern Taiwan’s city skyline.

The Grace Tower enjoys convenient transportation, located next to Airport MRT station A9 (Linkou) – a three‑minute walk away – and close to the National Highway 1 Linkou interchange, providing fast links to the Taipei metropolitan area and Taoyuan International Airport. Nearby commercial amenities include the Mitsui Outlet, and the surrounding area encompasses Linkou Chang Geng Hospital and other medical, business, and leisure facilities, offering the necessary conveniences for corporate headquarters, business reception, and tourism leisure.

paras: 根據當下現況、產業趨勢、個別公司營運狀況及未來展望，透過ChatGPT，未來3個月可優先觀察的6大族群、以及該注意提防的風險，重點分析整理

AI主線仍是核心，但現在已從「全面買AI」進入「選高成長、看訂單、看獲利、看量價」的階段。
目前台股指數雖然創高，但盤面已經出現「指數強、個股弱」的現象：9/23 加權指數收 48,157點、再創收盤新高，但成交金額降至約8,573億元，而且上市櫃近千檔下跌；台積電單日就貢獻約317點，占當日漲點近九成。這代表指數多頭仍強，但短線追價難度已明顯提高。
另一方面，基本面目前仍非常強。經濟部公布8月外銷訂單 1,029.6億美元、年增71.4%，首次突破單月1,000億美元，1～8月累計年增55%；9月外銷訂單預估仍達1,060～1,091億美元。這是目前台股AI基本面最重要的支撐之一。
一、未來3個月，我會優先觀察的6大族群
二、第一核心：台積電（2330-TW）
台灣積體電路製造
定位：AI多頭的核心權值股＋指數風向球
9/23 台積電收 2,500元，單日上漲40元，而且貢獻台股當日約九成漲點，顯示目前外資資金仍高度集中在最具基本面支撐的AI核心。
外資資料方面，FactSet 7月最新紀錄仍維持「強力買進」，目標價曾上調至3,090元；當然，這類目標價與目前市場價格已有落差，不能直接視為未來三個月的合理價位。
為什麼值得持續追蹤？
核心不是短線漲跌，而是：
AI GPU → ASIC → 先進製程 → CoWoS → HBM → 高速互連
整條產業鏈仍在擴張。
而且台灣8月外銷訂單創歷史新高，電子產品及資訊通信產品接單已大幅成長，對台積電中長期產能利用率形成支撐。
三個月觀察
2,500元能否形成新的整理平台。
如果能夠量縮守穩，再重新放量突破前高，技術面會比目前單純追價更健康。
三、第二核心：聯發科（2454-TW）
聯發科技
這檔反而是我認為未來三個月非常值得密切追蹤的AI ASIC標的。
最新消息是，9/24 歐系外資將聯發科目標價從 6,500元調高至7,300元，維持買進評等。
最值得注意的是：

Google TPU業務
新ASIC專案
2028～2029 EPS預估上修
TPU營收預估大幅上調
v9預計2026年11月前完成tape-out
後續可能在法說會進一步上調TPU展望


該外資甚至預估2028年EPS較市場共識高44%。
我的判斷
這已經不是單純「手機晶片股」邏輯。
而是逐漸轉向：
手機SoC → AI ASIC → Google TPU → 雲端AI運算
如果10月法說進一步確認TPU訂單與營收能見度，市場有機會重新評價聯發科的獲利結構。
最大風險
市場預期已經非常高。
所以真正重要的不是「有沒有AI題材」，而是：
實際營收與EPS能否跟上股價提前反映的預期。
四、第三核心：台達電（2308-TW）
台達電子
我會把台達電列入AI基礎建設最重要的中長線觀察股。
9/21 歐系外資將台達電目標價調升至 2,750元，主要理由是AI資料中心對電源、散熱及高功率架構的需求持續提升。
尤其值得注意：
400V／800V → HVDC → 高功率AI機櫃
這不是單純景氣循環，而是AI資料中心電力架構升級。
DIGITIMES統計，台灣AI伺服器機櫃最直接相關的散熱、電源、滑軌三大供應鏈，8月合計營收已達約1,214.8億元，顯示AI機櫃實際出貨仍在擴張。
三個月觀察
我會看：

AI電源出貨
HVDC進度
散熱產品ASP
毛利率
Q3/Q4營收


這類公司最大的優勢，是AI資本支出增加時，它不只是賣晶片，而是賣「資料中心基礎建設」。
五、第四核心：貿聯-KY（3665-TW）
貿聯-KY
這檔屬於我會特別注意的「AI電力＋高速互連雙成長」。
貿聯董事長9/15表示，目前下一代GPU伺服器案件已陸續啟動，而且ASIC需求也強，暫時沒有看到需求放緩；公司希望今年營運高點成為明年的低點。
更重要的是它不是只做GPU。
它同時受惠：
GPU → ASIC → Busbar → Power Whip → HVDC → 高速互連 → 光互連
而且CPO已經開始小量出貨。
7月外資也曾因6月獲利優於預期、毛利率回升而給予買進評等，目標價最高達3,665元。
三個月真正要觀察
不是CPO新聞，而是：
AI伺服器出貨量 × 單機價值 × 毛利率
如果三項同步向上，獲利彈性會非常大。
六、第五核心：金像電（2368-TW）／台光電（2383-TW）
這一區我會視為：
AI高速傳輸＋PCB/CCL的第二主升段候選區。
9/23盤面中，金像電、台光電、欣興（3037-TW）都屬於強勢AI硬體供應鏈；市場資金明顯集中到高階PCB、CCL、ABF載板。
其中金像電的法人預估也持續上修，FactSet 8月資料顯示2026 EPS預估約40.95元、目標價1,695元。
產業邏輯
AI伺服器升級：
800G → 1.6T → 更高速傳輸
帶動：
高階CCL → PCB → ABF → 高階載板
所以這個族群的關鍵不是一般消費電子復甦，而是：
AI伺服器每一代升級，材料與PCB價值量都提高。
但要特別注意
這一區現在最大問題是：
股價已經提前反映不少利多。
所以：
基本面好 ≠ 短線一定能漲。
我反而會等待：
量縮整理 → 月線附近止穩 → 再放量突破
而不是看到漲停就追。
七、第六核心：南亞科（2408-TW）——高彈性但高波動
南亞科技
這是目前比較特殊的一檔。
最新市場資訊顯示，瑞銀維持買進評等，目標價 640元，並預估2026 EPS約75.99元；市場主要邏輯是DRAM價格重新議價，以及AI伺服器需求擠壓傳統DRAM供給。
8月營收更達約447億元，年增約561%，前8月營收年增逾638%，顯示記憶體景氣已經出現非常強烈的週期反轉。
三個月最大催化劑
DRAM報價。
如果第四季報價繼續上漲，南亞科的EPS可能仍有上修空間。
但這檔和台積電不同：
台積電是成長股＋品質型；南亞科是高景氣循環＋高β。
因此波動風險明顯更大。
八、我會把「AI供應鏈」再分成三個層級
第一層：AI核心基礎建設
台積電／台達電／聯發科（2454-TW）
特點：
基本面最重要、產業地位高、AI需求直接。
第二層：AI高速傳輸
金像電／台光電／欣興／貿聯（3665-TW）
特點：
AI伺服器規格升級 → 單機價值提高 → EPS彈性較大。
第三層：高β成長
南亞科（2408-TW）／健策（3653-TW）／創意（3443-TW）／其他ASIC、CPO供應鏈
特點：
股價彈性大，但波動也最大。
因此如果是未來3個月，我反而不建議全部押在第三層。
九、未來3個月，我最看好的「產業排序邏輯」
不是股價排名，而是基本面催化劑的優先觀察順序：
① AI ASIC／先進製程
台積電、聯發科、創意
② AI電力／散熱
台達電、貿聯、健策
③ 高速PCB／CCL／ABF
金像電、台光電、欣興
④ 記憶體
南亞科
⑤ CPO／高速光互連
貿聯及相關光通訊供應鏈
十、目前台股最大的「矛盾」
這是我認為現在最重要的地方。
基本面：強。
股市位置：高。
資金：仍在。
估值：不便宜。
所以現在不是「AI行情結束」的問題，而是：
基本面能不能繼續超越市場原本已經很高的預期。
目前8月外銷訂單突破1,000億美元、年增71.4%，而且9月仍預估維持千億美元以上，顯示AI需求尚未出現明顯降溫。
因此我目前更傾向：
「多頭趨勢仍在，但選股難度提高。」
十一、接下來三個月最需要防的5大風險
1. 高檔量價背離
9/23台股創收盤新高，但成交金額縮到約8,573億元，而且下跌家數明顯多於上漲家數。
這種情況如果持續：
指數創高 → 成交量縮 → 上漲家數減少
就要小心市場進入高檔換手。
2. 美國利率重新轉鷹
9月Fed已升息25個基點至 3.75%～4.00%，且市場訊息顯示政策立場偏鷹，這會對高估值科技股形成壓力。
所以未來三個月一定要盯：
美國10年債殖利率＋美元＋Fed談話。
3. AI估值過高
這是目前最大結構性風險。
不是AI需求消失，而是：
AI需求很好，但股價漲得比EPS更快。
一旦法人開始下修估值倍數，即使公司營收仍成長，股價也可能先修正。
4. 地緣政治／油價
近期市場仍受到中東局勢、油價及全球通膨影響。
如果油價重新大幅上升：
油價↑ → 通膨↑ → 利率↑ → 科技股估值壓縮
這條鏈條仍然成立。
5. AI資本支出出現延後
這是我認為真正需要長期追蹤的風險。
目前鴻海仍表示AI需求強勁，並預期第三季表現優於市場預期；8月營收也達9218億元、年增51.98%。
所以目前沒有看到AI需求突然反轉的證據。
但未來要持續追蹤：
NVIDIA／Google／Microsoft／Amazon／Meta等大型CSP的CapEx是否持續上修。
十二、如果濃縮成「我的三個月觀察名單」
如果要我從目前資訊中整理成一份精簡版觀察清單，我會放：
AI核心
關鍵：先進製程、CoWoS、AI晶片需求。
AI ASIC
關鍵：Google TPU、新ASIC、2026年底～2027年訂單能見度。最新外資已將目標價上調至7,300元。
AI電源
關鍵：AI資料中心、800V/HVDC、高功率電源、散熱。
AI互連
關鍵：GPU＋ASIC＋Busbar＋HVDC＋高速互連。
AI PCB/CCL
關鍵：高速傳輸、AI伺服器、800G/1.6T。
高β記憶體
關鍵：DRAM價格＋供需缺口，但波動風險最高。
十三、最後給你一個「未來3個月操作框架」
我會用這個方式來看：
第一階段：9月底～10月
中秋連假後觀察外資是否持續回補、台積電能否站穩2,500元、台股48K是否由壓力轉支撐。
9/23外資仍買超373億元，三大法人合計買超389億元，資金面目前尚未出現明顯轉空訊號。
第二階段：10月
重點看Q3財報、台積電法說、AI ASIC訂單、PCB/CCL漲價及記憶體報價。
這一階段將決定：
「AI題材」能不能正式轉換成「EPS上修」。
第三階段：11～12月
看2027年獲利預估是否持續上修。
如果法人開始大幅上修：
2027 EPS → 2028 EPS → 目標價
那麼第二波行情才會真正具有基本面支撐。
最重要的結論
目前我不會把焦點放在「大盤會不會到多少點」，而會放在：
「誰的EPS還沒有完全反映AI需求？」
目前最值得追蹤的主線仍然是：
AI ASIC → 台積電先進製程 → 先進封裝 → 高速PCB/CCL → AI電源/散熱 → 高速互連 → 記憶體。
而現在最大的操作原則則是：
「強者恆強，但不追急漲；基本面要強、股價要有整理、量價要健康。」
尤其9/23已經出現「指數創高、個股分化、成交量下降」的現象，因此接下來最重要的不是看到AI就買，而是等待營收／EPS上修＋量價突破兩個條件同步出現。
如果以你平常關注的 AI供應鏈／EPS成長股角度，我會特別把 聯發科、台達電、貿聯、金像電、台光電、南亞科列為接下來3個月值得持續追蹤的核心名單；但其中股價漲幅、估值與技術面位置差異很大，不能把「基本面看好」直接等同於「現在適合追價」。
投資最怕的不是震盪
而是看對卻沒做
機會來了卻不敢上車
選對產業→比追逐消息更重要
踩準節奏→比每天猜高低更關鍵
一年裡難得遇到1-2個月整理或拉回
預測下週多頭會有大反撲的機會
看看新主流在哪好好地換過去
只有在整理的時候最容易看清楚
如果你9月份錯過
